observation_basis_vocabulary.OWNER_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE: Observations recorded by the owner/operator during execution and exported as pinned evidence; independently re-verified by this reviewer only by comparing pinned artifacts, not by re-execution.
observation_basis_vocabulary.CODEX_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE: Operational evidence produced and frozen by Local Codex (environment fixture, migration, server operation, intake checks).
observation_basis_vocabulary.RTK_PROXY_BASH_SEMANTICS_PROBE: Reviewer-executed isolated shell-semantics probe (single bash expression, no owner code execution) used to reproduce a language-level defect claim.
observation_basis_vocabulary.ARTIFACT_ONLY: Reviewer read a frozen packet artifact (manifest, report, scan output) without access to the underlying execution.
observation_basis_vocabulary.SOURCE_ONLY: Reviewer read frozen source/plan text; no execution or artifact of execution is claimed.
observation_basis_vocabulary.NONE: No usable independent or owner evidence exists for the criterion.

semantics.reviewer_personal_runtime_execution: NOT_run_and_no_runtime_claim — the reviewer executed no product, harness, observer, server or database lifecycle action. Reviewer-executed probes are limited to: pure read/hash operations, generic-manifest verification scripts, a 2-expression bash `if !` semantics probe, and lstat/readlink on an existing symlink.

verdict_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Material sub-evidence exists (some clauses evidenced), but acceptance-blocking gaps (independent QA pending, owner-vs-original-assignee deviations, or corrected-disposition runtime gaps) remain.
verdict_vocabulary.FAIL: A criterion clause is directly contradicted by verified evidence.
verdict_vocabulary.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: The retained evidence cannot establish the criterion clause.
